title: Art Theme Manifest
description: data/art/themes/<theme>/theme.json: describes one theme pack (a culture such as Greek, or an event such as Thanksgiving). The pack's pieces live beside it in the same <kind>/<family>/ layout as the core library (wardrobe/, cosmetics/, backgrounds/<realm>/).

id.description: 'themes/' + group folder + '/' + the theme folder name

type.description: culture = a lasting world style; event = a seasonal/holiday pack that can be switched on for a period
